_comment: This file is the single source of truth for every board.
refresh = seconds between board refreshes (minimum 300, enforced in-script).
status: omit it, or set 'available'. Set it to 'sold' to hide a parcel
from every board at once without deleting the record.
label: keep it short. Buttons truncate at 24 bytes including the 'N. ' prefix,
so roughly 20 characters of name is what shows.
x, y, z: the point inside the parcel you want the map to open at.
Stand on the spot in-world and read the coordinates off the location bar.
